newsitem.title: UK: Ibstock shares up after newspaper comment.
newsitem.headline: Ibstock shares up after newspaper comment.

text.p: Shares in Ibstock Plc rose on Monday after positive comments on the British brick manufacturer in the Sunday Telegraph newspaper, dealers said.
By 1153 GMT, Ibstock shares were 4-1/2p firmer at 74p.
The newspaper said Ibstock had been singled out by analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett as a strong buy.
"Ibstock should benefit from its exposure to a strengthening UK construction and house building market," the Sunday Telegraph said.

"Rising activity will eat into stock surpluses and boost prices across the sector while Ibstock should see additional benefits come through soon in its acquisitions from Tarmac and Redland," it added.
